Subject: Project Update: Revised Delivery Date of 14 April

We're writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for the platform needed additional certification steps beyond what was originally scoped, and that process has taken longer than the vendor initially indicated. As a result, the project schedule has moved by two weeks.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing work on all other components in parallel, and the certification is now in its final stage with the vendor, so we do not anticipate any further changes to this date. We'll keep you updated on progress in the meantime.

Does the 14 April date work with your internal planning, or are there any milestones on your end we should factor in before then? Please let us know if you'd like to schedule a call to walk through the updated timeline in detail.
